claims.text: The blog measures FLUX.2-klein-4B with documented methodology: Diffusers FluxPipeline bf16 flow-matching scheduler on H100 SXM 80 GB; 5 resolutions x 3 step counts; CLIP alignment over 10 categories plus LPIPS plus attribute binding plus batch ramp 1-16 plus data-parallel 1/2/4/8 plus cost.

Reported numbers: 512px-4-step 0.19 s (5.14 img/s), 768px 0.33 s, 1280x720 0.50 s, 1024px-4-step 0.57 s (1.77 img/s), 1024px-8-step 1.00 s, 1024px-12-step 1.43 s; VRAM 16 GB at 512px to 17.8 GB at 1024px (16-18 GB); peak batch-8 1.91 img/s; data-parallel 1:0.43, 2:0.82 (97%), 4:1.48 (87%), 8:2.53 (74%); CLIP average 0.335 across categories, flat across step counts (2-step 0.375 to 12-step 0.367); ~$0.0004/image at stated cloud price, 5-10x SDXL.
